chain_words.nuance: to signal a claim indirectly, without stating it
to put forward a claim tentatively
to state a claim confidently as true
to argue firmly that something is the case
to maintain a claim forcefully, refusing to yield

explanation: These words all describe putting forward a claim, from an indirect hint to a forceful refusal to yield.

usage_notes.difference: 'Assert' means stating a claim confidently; 'insist' adds a stronger sense of refusing to accept any objection.
